In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 4-space]], the '''order-4 24-cell honeycomb''' is one of two paracompact [[regular polytope|regular]] space-filling [[tessellation]]s (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycombs]]). It is called ''paracompact'' because it has infinite [[vertex figures]], with all vertices as [[ideal point]]s at infinity. With [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,4,3,4}, it has four [[24-cell]]s around each face. Acronym: n/a{{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/x3o4o3o4o.htm (x3o4o3o4o)]}}

It is [[dual polytope|dual]] to the [[cubic honeycomb honeycomb]].

== Related honeycombs ==
It is related to the regular Euclidean 4-space [[24-cell honeycomb]], {3,4,3,3}, with [[24-cell]] facets.
